name: cwd-workspace
description: Bind-mounts the host directory run.sh was invoked from at /workspace, so the agent works directly on your local checkout.

settings.label: Workspace directory
settings.description: Host directory mounted at /workspace. Default: the project's directory.

settings.label: Hidden paths
settings.description: Space-separated paths inside it the container must not see; each is shadowed by an empty read-only file.
